legacy_title: EFRAG IG 2: Value Chain Implementation Guidance
evidence: EFRAG issuer/EU scope; EFRAG-VC chunks reference IG2 summary points, section 2.5 value-chain coverage, section 2.1 leverage and Annex 2 business relationships. Index summary identifies the same upstream/downstream IRO guidance.

legacy_title: EFRAG IG 1: Materiality Assessment Implementation Guidance
evidence: EFRAG issuer/EU scope; MA-IG chunks concern double materiality, severity scale/scope/irremediability, likelihood, stakeholders, group consolidation and unconditional ESRS 2 disclosure. These distinguish IG1 from IG2 and match the indexed materiality guidance.

European Parliament/Council issuer; CSRD chunks identify recital 47 double materiality, article 19a(3) value chains, article 29b(4) SME proportionality and article 40a third-country reporting. Index summary identifies the same directive despite its misspelled title.

canonical_title: Sustainability Reporting Handbook for Vietnamese Companies
